failure_registry.control: Never repeat a verified setup check unless a real operation fails.
Verify consequential destinations before delivery or submission.
Use connectors/tools first; owner gets only irreducible credential/KYC/approval actions.
Check canonical ledger/state before execution; revisions do not create new economic claims.
Lead with collected revenue/received value, then pipeline; never reverse the hierarchy.
Exactly one governing state per serious objective; subordinate queues cannot override it.
Stop research when evidence supports a decision; execute the highest-value reversible action.
Paid behavior earns further build investment; prototypes do not.
Recompute totals from row-level records whenever accounting state changes.
First-party payment evidence supersedes older workbook/chat $0 states immediately.

enforcement_rules: Canonical state > connected first-party evidence > primary source > structured export > high-quality secondary > inference.
Changing project status belongs in canonical project state, not durable personal memory.
AI#1 allocates resources; it does not duplicate detailed execution ledgers.
Research projects cannot silently become execution authorities.
Collected cash/received value and net economics are the top portfolio metrics.
Unknown is an allowed and preferred state when evidence is insufficient.
No monetary spend without explicit scope and amount authorization.
No new product or infrastructure build when an existing paid experiment has a higher-value conversion action.

Chargeback referral economics require provider confirmation and a real permissioned merchant before revenue can be booked.
Etsy optimization requires current first-party seller/Marketplace Insights data before strong commercial conclusions.
